headline: Uncertainty clouds near-term outlook

highlights: Revenue declined 12% YoY to INR 26.4bn, while EBITDA margin contracted 750bps YoY to 3.5%, including the impact of a one-time provision.
With the execution uncertainty persisting alongside elevated working capital requirements, management has refrained from providing a FY27 guidance.
While order inflows (OI) have picked up, with YTD inflows of INR 194bn, timely execution and cash conversion remain key monitorable.
Its order book (OB; including L1) stands at INR 472bn (4.3x TTM revenue), providing healthy revenue visibility.
valuation: Moreover, the management still remains uncertain on execution front and refrains from giving guidance for FY27, as a result we trim our multiple to 12x (vs. 17x earlier).
The views and opinions expressed in this document may or may not match or may be contrary with the views, estimates, rating, and target price of the Retail Research.
watch: While order inflows (OI) have picked up, with YTD inflows of INR 194bn, timely execution and cash conversion remain key monitorable.
Key downside risks: 1) Delays in execution of projects; 2) delays in payments from customers; thereby, increasing the receivables position; and 3) lower-than-expected OI.
